integrity: Self-contained proof and standalone finite sanity-check program are supplied; finite enumeration is not a proof of the unbounded theorem. No external independent audit or historical priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The complete criterion and enumeration are for binary circles with four ones. A family at every higher weight disproves only the naive extremal-gap adjacency extension, without classifying all those circles. Unindexed equivalent historical work remains possible. The leading source date is that of the cited foundational work, not of this theorem.
title: Four-marker circular prefix-normality: an exact gap criterion and forbidden-necklace series
